The capability-based restore can overwrite newer live card data when host events arrive while the asynchronous restore is pending. This leaves the new no-toolInfo recovery path vulnerable to the event-ordering race it is intended to handle.

Review comment:

- [P2] Ignore restore responses superseded by live output — /Users/burakemre/Code/lobu/.claude/worktrees/mcp-app-v8/packages/owletto/src/mcp-apps/_shared/host.tsx:311-315
  When a no-`toolInfo` host starts this restore from an empty replay, a later non-empty `toolresult` or `openai:set_globals` update can install current data while the request is pending. The response is then applied unconditionally here, replacing the newer result—including current actions and view state—with the older display-only snapshot; capture the capability/data generation and discard the response if it changed while awaiting.
